settings.heading: Giving shoes a second chance
settings.text: In an effort to reduce our environmental footprint and prevent unnecessary waste, we're excited to announce our Second Chance Program. A rare opportunity to get your hands on products no longer available on our website, or refurbished inventory, at a discount while supplies last. Keep an eye out for new inventory appearing frequently; you never know what you'll find.

settings.checkbox_content:
Please acknowledge the following terms and conditions before shopping Second Chance footwear.

• The Second Chance collection may contain products that are new, refurbished, discontinued, or may feature a small cosmetic or packaging defect.

• Second Chance models do not include damaged, harshly worn footwear that would otherwise not meet the criteria to be included in this program.

• Second Chance models are FINAL SALE and can not be exchanged or returned.

• Second Chance models are not covered by our 30-Day Trial, Waterproof Warranty, or any other protections against product defects or wear and tear.

• No other offers or promotions may be combined with Second Chance inventory.
settings.checkbox_text: By checking this box and shopping the Second Chance collection, you agree to the terms and conditions stated above.
